nodes.label: Daily content on a data branch Plan
nodes.rationale: Move the generated daily index off main so main stops accruing chore(daily) bot commits, while preserving production freshness, per-date provenance, and the scheduled-workflow keepalive. Rewriting the 137 existing bot commits was declined by the owner. Tombstoned 2026-06-12 (daily removed in PR #97).

nodes.label: Orphan data branch for the daily index
nodes.rationale: The bot commits index.json to an orphan data branch 4x/day; deploy.yml fetches it from there at build time with a generate-fallback so a missing or stale branch cannot break a deploy. Orphan (not a normal branch) so the content history never entangles with source history.

nodes.label: Generate-on-demand index for dev and e2e
nodes.rationale: Once the index is untracked, local dev and Playwright would have no file to serve; a predev npm script and a playwright.config webServer regeneration keep both environments self-sufficient without re-tracking a generated artifact.
